Cities FAQ

01

My suburb is not listed—can you still come?

Usually yes. Metro pages cover the wider urban area. Call 1-888-XXX-XXXX with your street address or plant gate.

02

Why is each city one link?

The hub lists one entry per metro. That page links to environmental spill response locally; national service pages cover all of Canada.

03

Do you work after hours?

Yes—emergency spill response runs 24/7. Remediation projects may follow disposal facility hours.
